title: Home
description: Al Jamia Arts and Science College, Perinthalmanna — established 2010, affiliated to the University of Calicut. UG (Honours) and PG programmes in Arts, Science, Commerce and Computing.

about.heading: Al Jamia Arts and Science College (AJASC)
paragraphs: At AJASC, education goes beyond textbooks and degree certificates. We focus on holistic student development.
AJASC was founded with a clear, noble purpose: to uplift educationally developing communities by delivering accessible, value-based, and world-class education.

chairman_message.heading: Chairman’s message
paragraphs: Welcome to Al Jamia Arts & Science College (AJAS). Our goal is not only to produce professionally competent graduates who succeed in global careers, but also to mould compassionate, conscious citizens who contribute meaningfully to their communities and the nation.

As you step into the vibrant academic community at AJAS, I invite you to embrace every opportunity to learn, innovate and grow. Together, let us strive for excellence and build a future rooted in knowledge, integrity and service.

principal_message.kicker: Dr. (Lt. Cdr. Rtd.) C. K. Abdul Rabbi Nistar
principal_message.heading: Principal’s message
principal_message.quote: “Education is not merely about academic achievement; it is about building character, inspiring purpose, and transforming lives. At AJAS, we aim to instill in our students the clarity, competence, and values necessary to excel in an ever-evolving world.”
bullet_points: Established in 2010, affiliated to the University of Calicut.
Minority status, recognised by the Government of Kerala.
A curriculum, campus and faculty tailored to modern arts and science education.

programmes.heading: Programmes offered
programmes.intro: Empowering students through university-affiliated four-year honours degrees and postgraduate specialisations designed for career excellence and higher research.

pg.title: PG Programmes
pg.highlight_text: Advanced research supervision, high-impact clinical and industry internships, and specialist training aligned with Calicut University curriculum.

departments.title: Department of Arabic
departments.description: Excellence in Arabic linguistics, literature, translation, and cultural studies with dedicated research faculty.

departments.title: Department of Commerce & Management Studies
departments.description: A vibrant centre of learning offering honours degrees in accounting, finance, taxation, and business management.

departments.title: Department of Computer Application
departments.description: Modern software development, web technologies, and systems administration with practical hands-on labs.

departments.title: Department of Computer Science & AI
departments.description: Specialised curriculum covering artificial intelligence, machine learning, data structures, and computing algorithms.

departments.title: Department of English
departments.description: Critical literary analysis, communicative linguistics, creative writing, and media studies since 2010.

departments.title: Department of Food Technology
departments.description: Food preservation, quality assurance, nutrition analysis, and product development in state-of-the-art labs.

departments.title: Department of Geography
departments.description: Geospatial science, GIS mapping, remote sensing, and environmental studies backed by field research.

departments.title: Department of Microbiology
departments.description: Immunology, medical microbiology, virology, and biotechnology with active clinical lab coursework.

departments.title: PG Department of Psychology
departments.description: Comprehensive mental health, clinical psychology, counselling and experimental psychology programmes.

departments.title: Department of Islamic Studies
departments.description: Rigorous academic study of Islamic history, civilization, philosophy, ethics, and contemporary thought.

departments.title: Department of Islamic Finance
departments.description: Specialised postgraduate degree combining ethical Islamic finance principles with modern banking systems.

departments.title: Department of Languages
departments.description: Prescribed common and second language courses including Malayalam, Hindi, Arabic, and English.

items.title: Library
items.text: A reference and lending library with OPAC access, journals, e-resources and dedicated reading space for every department.

items.title: Laboratories
items.text: Computer, Artificial Intelligence, Psychology, Geography, Microbiology, Physics and Food Technology labs, equipped for hands-on coursework.

items.title: Seminar Hall
items.text: An air-conditioned seminar hall used for conferences, guest lectures, workshops and departmental programmes throughout the year.

benefits.heading: Why choose AJAS?

items.title: Value-based education
items.text: A curriculum built to enrich, enlighten and empower — shaping character alongside academic achievement.

items.title: Recognised & accredited
items.text: Minority status, affiliation to the University of Calicut, Government of Kerala recognition and ISO certification.

items.title: Skills & placement
items.text: Add-on certificate courses, ASAP, Keltron, G-Tec and NPTEL/SWAYAM pathways, backed by an active placement cell.

items.title: Research & innovation
items.text: Faculty publications, patents and an Innovation & Entrepreneurship Development Centre driving student projects.

benefits.cta_text: Merit and management seats are open for 2026–27 across every UG Honours and PG programme.

quick_link_cta.heading: Ready to get started?
quick_link_cta.text: Al Jamia Arts and Science College is a resourceful destination for higher studies in the region — affiliated to the University of Calicut, recognised by the Government of Kerala and holding minority status. Apply online or visit the campus at Poopalam, Perinthalmanna.
